tokens.name: ct-ground
tokens.usage: The page. Grit sits on it. Night is full black, never a tinted near-black; daylight is glacier ice, never white.

tokens.name: ct-panel
tokens.usage: Inside frames, fields, toasts, tags and table rows. No grit on panels.

tokens.name: ct-ink
tokens.usage: All body text and titles, outlines that must be seen, checked boxes, thumbs. 18.7:1 on night ground, 16.3:1 on ice.

tokens.name: ct-ink-2
tokens.usage: Captions, hints, table headers, idle nav words. 8.4:1 on night ground, 6.3:1 on ice, 7.8:1 on snow.

tokens.name: ct-line
tokens.usage: Outlines and traces at rest: field and frame edges, unchecked boxes, slider trace. 3.9:1 on night ground, 3.7:1 on ice.

tokens.name: ct-rule
tokens.usage: Decoration only: table rules, etch lines, idle routing. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: ct-well
tokens.usage: Inside slots and tracks (breaker slot, toggle track, slider well). Always under the frost lattice.

tokens.name: ct-sock
tokens.usage: The hard block under every key and handle. Depth is this block, never a shadow. Always frosted.

tokens.name: ct-key
tokens.usage: Prime key face and breaker handle.

tokens.name: ct-key-ink
tokens.usage: The word on a prime key; grip lines on a handle.

tokens.name: ct-flash
tokens.usage: The landing spark when a key hits its socket. Animation only.

tokens.name: ct-live
tokens.usage: Current on: success, charged, on. Lines, vias and fills of traces only. In daylight never a word colour (3.8:1 on snow).

tokens.name: ct-signal
tokens.usage: Current near: focus rings, hover, selection, links. 3.9:1 on ice, 4.8:1 on snow.

tokens.name: ct-arc
tokens.usage: Current carrying data: info states and the second chart series. 4.8:1 on ice.

tokens.name: ct-fault
tokens.usage: Fault only: errors, cuts, destructive keys. The one warm colour. May write its own error words (6.2:1 on snow).

tokens.name: ct-fault-sock
tokens.usage: The block under a Cut key. Never used elsewhere.

tokens.name: ct-series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (lines and line-ends only). Validated with series 2 for colour-vision separation and lightness in both modes.

tokens.name: ct-series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. More than two series: small multiples, not more colours.

styles.name: ct-title
styles.usage: One per page, the name. font-stretch: 150%. Clamp down to 44px on phones.

styles.name: ct-display
styles.usage: Hero headlines and big numbers. font-stretch: 150%. Never under 44px.

styles.name: ct-readout
styles.usage: Live values and stat tiles. font-stretch: 150%, tabular numbers.

styles.name: ct-panel-title
styles.usage: Block and panel titles, led by a via. font-stretch: 125%.

styles.name: ct-label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav, legends. font-stretch: 112%. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: ct-body
styles.sample: Line 4 is live at 62%. Re-route trace 7 before the next charge.
styles.usage: Everything read at length, and every number that changes. Max 65 characters a line.

styles.name: ct-cap
styles.sample: Shown in the log and on every alert.

spacing.note: Named after chip parts. Use only these steps.

tokens.name: ct-via
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps.

tokens.name: ct-pitch
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: ct-pin
tokens.usage: Key travel, label to field, icon to text.

tokens.name: ct-pad
tokens.usage: Inside small panels; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: ct-lane
tokens.usage: Between controls; panel padding.

tokens.name: ct-bus
tokens.usage: Between columns.

tokens.name: ct-bank
tokens.usage: Between blocks.

tokens.name: ct-die
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Cold Trace has no rounded corners. These are 45-degree chamfers cut at the top-left and bottom-right corners with clip-path; border-radius stays 0 except on vias, which are full circles.

tokens.name: ct-cut-s
tokens.usage: Chamfer for checks, thumbs, tags, segmented options.

tokens.name: ct-cut-m
tokens.usage: Chamfer for keys, fields, toasts, tiles.

tokens.name: ct-cut-l
tokens.usage: Chamfer for panels, screens, the lever key.

easing.note: Nothing steps and nothing is linear. A hand's action lands within 250ms.

tokens.name: ct-drop
tokens.usage: Throw: a key accelerates into a hard stop.

tokens.name: ct-spring
tokens.usage: Release: springs past its mark and back.

tokens.name: ct-current
tokens.usage: Pulse laps, charging fills, orbits.

tokens.name: ct-arrive
tokens.usage: Cuts, sparks, toasts arriving.

tokens.name: ct-spark
tokens.usage: A landing flash.

tokens.name: ct-snap
tokens.usage: A key's drop; a thumb's snap.

tokens.name: ct-run
tokens.usage: Release, cut, most state changes.

tokens.name: ct-surge
tokens.usage: A trace filling with current.
